Particular experiences working in universities, startups, and companies. I've worked in teaching assistantships, research internships, contract positions, and startup companies.

```{python}
import yaml
from os import path
from IPython.display import display, Markdown, HTML

import sys
sys.path.append(path.abspath(path.join('..', '..')))
import utils.helpers as h

with open("./items.yaml") as f:
    raw_items = yaml.safe_load(f)
    items = sorted(raw_items, key=lambda x: (x['dates'][0]['year'], x['dates'][0]['month'], x['title']), reverse=True)
    contents = h.portfolio_grid_items(items)
    display(HTML(contents))
```
